title: Linear Hypergraphs with Dimension 3
exact_target: Can every simple linear hypergraph of incidence-poset dimension at most three be represented by common intersections of planar triangles and segments?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, supplied problems.json, record 3326 (OPG-596), OpenGarden. Catalogue identity and source transcription; CC BY 4.0.
Open Problem Garden, Linear Hypergraphs with Dimension 3. Original problem and discussion.
H. de Fraysseix, P. Ossona de Mendez and P. Rosenstiehl, Representation of Planar Hypergraphs by Contacts of Triangles, Graph Drawing 2007.

status_qualification: Makes explicit the simple/Sperner hypergraph and maximal-common-intersection convention described in the source background.
